sonnet.problem: The question says Hilkiah has the money and asks where it goes next. Verse 10 says only 'They put it into the hands of those supervising the work.' It doesn't say Hilkiah is the one who hands it on, so the card settles who passes the money.
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open. Who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.
